title: AcmeDB: Should you give a shit?
subject: AcmeDB
take: Fast on a laptop, nowhere near prod ready
summary: AcmeDB promises p99 reads under 2ms on a laptop, which is cute. But backups are still coming soon and cross-region replication is just a roadmap bullet. Until those ship, it is a toy, not a database you bet on.

receipts.evidence: Cross-region replication is on the roadmap.
p99 read latency under 2ms on a laptop.

bottom_line: Skip AcmeDB until snapshots and replication actually ship. Revisit when coming soon becomes shipped.
